# intn_fleet_seal_ranges

Manage security seal/label numeric ranges and issuance for enabling and annual inspection flows.

**Grupo:** `intn_fleet` · **Versión:** 18.0.1.1.2 · **Categoría:** Fleet

**Depende de:** `intn_fleet_cistern_fines`, `intn_fleet_cistern_seals`, `intn_organization`, `intn_portal_fleet_requests`, `intn_service_request`, `mail`, `sale`, `web_intn_seal_capture`
